title: Looks nice but not worth the price
text: Looks nice but not worth the price. The instructions are vague. The suction is not the greatest. Mine didn't come with the extra sealing gasket like it said it does. Last but not least it doesn't say what bags to buy.  I guess you buy whatever is the best value.
